task: Find the park that offers the cheapest paddling permits.
agent_final_answer: The park offering the cheapest paddling permit is McInnis Canyons National Conservation Area (BLM), Near Grand Junction, Colorado. Its "Ruby Horsethief Canyon Permits" is the cheapest paddling permit on Recreation.gov, ranking #1 when the paddling permit search results are sorted by Price (low to high). Its only required cost is a $6.00 non-refundable reservation fee (recreation/camping fees only apply in-season). By comparison, the next cheapest, the Desolation Gray - Green River Permit, requires a $6 reservation fee plus a $40-per-person recreation fee ($46 minimum).
